unsupported_shapes.reason: The public generator could not create an application repository and rejected the minimal manifest without actionable schema diagnostics, so no Blog/CMS contract or generated typed command/query shapes could be authored.

explanation: This sealed, fresh Rust evaluation could not construct a RiffDB application from the public interfaces. riffdb new rejected an existing empty destination, then twice reported that a requested new repository could not be written. riffdb application generate and riffdb-dev --acceptance rejected the minimal manifest with only a generic invalid-manifest failure. No public manifest schema or template was available in the bundle. I did not invent a contract, generated bindings, credentials, transport, codecs, kernel calls, or client-side joins. Consequently no typed Blog/CMS write, named feed/moderation/slug/detail operation, detail-page read, seed data, boundary pass, or golden workload could be demonstrated. The one-point rating reflects that the public Rust SDK exposes an application-first facade, but the supplied public authoring path was insufficient to bootstrap the required application.
